parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, no arrest pattern, no police targeting, no facility ban, and health policy is expressly non-discriminatory on gender identity; senior officials endorse Pride (3,000 at 2019 march), and 2024 decrees name trans people and bar unauthorised disclosure of gender identity. These are genuine documented positives. Against them: no gender-identity hate-crime or anti-discrimination coverage anywhere, so an outed visitor has essentially no recourse; reported verbal abuse and discrimination in public services including medical centres reach visitors; the 2017 foreign-government report finds trans people subject to societal stigma and violence limiting health-care access. That is tier-3 hostility with thin/no remedy — no tier-1 universal exposure (border screening, custody placement, ward rules all undocumented, hence light open questions), and no organised targeting. Social-acceptance positives and absent recourse roughly offset, placing it at 0.55-anchor level, a touch above on the official-climate evidence.
